desc:
🏍️ Welcome to +1 Speed Motorcycle Tsunami Escape!

How to Play:
🏍️ Every ride makes you faster!
🌊 Avoid waves to earn wins!
⚡ Unlock powerful motorcycles that give insane speed multipliers!
💪 Train on treadmills or ride across the map to increase your speed!
🔥 Rebirth to gain multipliers and become even faster!

If you’re having fun, don’t forget to like the game! 👍
